items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released isolated patch files for APSB26-92, fixing seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type)
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code by uploading malicious files.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, exploitable by an attacker with high privileges without user interaction.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP Object Injection)
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service.
